title: NEC bathroom receptacles (NFPA 70, 2023)
notes: NFPA 70 is behind a login; the values are from trade summaries (S0893, S0894). The 406.9(C) zone stops at walls, doors and fixed barriers, which Reviera does not yet cut it by; its exceptions (680.73, the far-wall receptacle in small bathrooms, ceiling receptacles for luminaires, an electronic toilet seat's receptacle) are not modelled. GFCI protection (210.8) and the 20 A circuit (210.11(C)(3)) are circuit data Reviera does not check here. The luminaire and switch rules (410.10(D), 404.4(C)) were not verified and are left out.

receptacles.description: No receptacle inside a tub or shower or within 3 ft (900 mm) of its outside edge, up to 8 ft (2.5 m) above its rim or threshold; in a dwelling, at least one receptacle within 3 ft (900 mm) of each basin's outside edge
